subject: Insurance
title: Liability: The Foundation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Liability: The Foundation.

hook.text: Liability insurance pays when you hurt someone else. It's required in 49 states.

buildup.text: Liability covers two things: bodily injury (medical bills) and property damage (fixing the other person's car).

discovery.text: State minimums are dangerously low. California requires only $15,000 per person. One serious injury can cost $500,000.

twist.text: If the damage exceeds your liability limit, the victim can sue you personally.

climax.text: Liability insurance protects others—and protects you from financial ruin. The minimum is a floor, not a ceiling.

quiz.question: What does liability auto insurance cover?
options: Injuries and property damage you cause to others
